units.source_text: “这是诗人国木田独步，他对卧轨自杀的体力劳动者的心情感同身受。

en.t: This is the poet Kunikida Doppo, who deeply sympathized with the feelings of laborers who committed suicide by lying on the railway tracks.
I suppose there is no need for me to introduce him to you.

units.source_text: 下面一请看第五个神龛……”

en.t: Next, please look at the fifth shrine..."
